Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator failed to gather the critical piece of information needed to solve the problem: the list of C-suite members at the time of the IPO. Instead of successfully retrieving this historical data through persistent and effective web searches (despite multiple attempts and replanning), it prematurely relied on "educated guesses" in its final fact sheet. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Eliran Glazer and Shiran Nawi were not in C-suite roles during the IPO. In reality, Eliran Glazer (CFO) was a key executive at the time of the IPO, and the Orchestrator's failure to verify this fact before answering resulted in a wrong solution.
